.. _dependencies_and_canonicals:

Dependencies and canonicals
===========================

A project's scope is its own resources plus the packages it depends on. Simplifier looks up every canonical reference in that scope when it validates, renders and generates snapshots. The pages below explain how to manage the scope, how references are resolved in it, and how to claim and resolve canonical URLs.
